title: Yummy Sour Light Jamaican Duck Legs Tagine
description: A one-pot Jamaican dish featuring tender duck legs in a tangy and flavorful broth. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the duck legs and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the allspice, thyme, and chili flakes, and stir to combine.
Pour in the lime juice and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the duck is tender, about 25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and garnish with cilantro if desired.
Serve the duck and sauce hot, over rice or with some crusty bread.
Deglaze the pot with a little water to remove any remaining browned bits, and serve as a sauce.
Discard any remaining sauce and serve the duck with a side of steamed vegetables.
Leftover sauce can be refrigerated or frozen for later use.
